notes: Two final runs per workload. Loopback fixtures, not phone/provider guarantees.
Asymmetric pool: 8 resolvers in 4 pairs, 44..204 ms path delay, 8-request hard limit, 14 idle streams, 256 KiB byte-verified transfer.
Loaded application: 4 one-member groups, 4 simultaneous 32 KiB uploads with echo readback, 20 ms base DNS delay and 8 ms additional delay per request above 8 in flight.
Interactive p95 measures a separate application echo through actual tunnel data admission, not a bypassing control probe.
XOR was off during throughput benchmarks; obfuscation/MTU/tuner paths are covered separately by race tests.
Mixed-pool baseline upload varies widely; keep every result and do not infer a fixed resolver capacity from these timings.
